main_failure_modes: The low-confidence Planning fallacy finding over-interprets a low-end estimate despite the participant's use of the historical range, task-specific reasoning, slippage caveat, and near-plan outcome.
If candidate-inclusive performance is compared, the Confirmation bias and Anchoring candidates add unsupported detections on negative segments.
main_strengths: The RAG uses valid interview quotations and localizes each finding to the relevant decision episode.
It assigns low confidence to its only identified occurrence and keeps the two weaker hypotheses as candidates rather than promoting them to identified findings.
Its candidate explanations acknowledge the counterevidence and uncertainty in the participant's actual decisions.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This is a zero-bias control interview. At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold the system produces no findings and correctly rejects every eligible segment. The low-confidence tier introduces one false alarm; including candidates raises the false-alarm rate to 0.75 and lowers segment accuracy to 0.25. No dataset-level or corpus-condition conclusions can be drawn from this single run.
